sentences.text: JUDGMENT

The claimant in O.P.(MV)No.1331 of 2017 on the files of the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal,
Manjeri is the appellant herein.
2. The claimant who claims to be a Lab Technician, met with an accident on 02.08.2017 around 4.30 p.m.
While she was standing on the side of the road at Keezhumparamba, an autorickshaw bearing Registration No. KL-10/AD-8882 came in a rash and negligent manner and knocked her down.
The claimant contended that, she was drawing a monthly income of Rs. 14,000/-.
In support of her claim, Exts.A1 to A10 documents were marked.
No documentary or oral evidence was adduced on the side of the 2024:KER:93378 insurance company.
The claimant further contended that, she had suffered permanent disability on account of the accident and in order to prove the same, she was referred to the Medical Board.
The Medical Board in turn examined the claimant and found that the claimant had sustained partial disability of 8%.

The tribunal however, proceeded to consider the claim of the appellant and fixed the notional income at Rs.11,500/- and granted the following compensation:-

hospital 3

clothing & articles 5 By stander 5,600 400x14 expenses

 for  2024:KER:93378  pain&suffering

2  life

11 Inconvenience, 120,000 Nil  hardship etc...
 12 Mental and 8,000/- Nil  physical shock  Total Rs. 8,00,00/- Rs. 4,66,756/-( rounded  to Rs. 4,67,000/-)
Aggrieved by the insufficiency in relation to the grant of compensation that the appellant has approached this Court.
3. Heard Sri. K.Vidyasagar, learned counsel appearing for the appellant and Smt. Latha Susan Cherian, learned Standing Counsel appearing for the insurance company.
4. The primary question falls for consideration of this Court is as to whether the tribunal was justified in fixing 2024:KER:93378 the notional income of the claimant at Rs. 11,500/-.
It is pertinent here to note that the claimant had contended that she was drawing a monthly income of Rs.14000/-.

In Sanjay Kumar v. Ashok Kumar & Another [2014 (5) SCC 330], the Hon'ble Apex Court held that even in the absence of a documentary evidence, if the claim of the claimant regarding the income is realistic, then the tribunal can fix the same without insisting on any documentary evidence.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In this regard it is pertinent to mention that, even going by the provisions contained under the Minimum Wages Act, the appellant/claimant is entitled for more amount, but however, chose only to claim Rs.14,000/-.
Hence, this Court is of the considered view that, an amount of Rs.14,000/- can be fixed as the income of the claimant.
5. In so far as the other non-conventional heads are concerned, the claimant is entitled to a reasonable enhancement.
6. In the result, the appeal stands allowed.
The income of the claimant is fixed at Rs.14,000/- and the 2024:KER:93378 appellant is entitled to enhanced compensation as follows:-
S.No. Head of Claim Amount Amount The amount Claimed Awarded enhanced by the High Court 1 Loss of earnings 2,00,000/- 69,000/- 57,000 [14,000x9-  69000]

2 Compensation 3,50,000/- 2,62,752/- 57,120  for permanent [(19,600x12x  disability 17x8/100)-
 2,62,752]
 3 Compensation 1,00,000/- 30,000/- 15,000  for  pain&suffering  4 Compensation 20,000/- 15000  for loss of  amenities  Total 1,44,120 Sumi vs Mahaboob V.P on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163309472/
3 Thus, a total amount of Rs. 1,44,120/- (Rupees One lakh fourty four thousand one twenty only) is awarded as enhanced compensation.
The said amount will carry interest at 8% per annum from 16.12.2017 till realization together with proportionate costs.
The Insurance Company is directed to deposit the aforesaid amount within a period of two month 2024:KER:93378 from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
While calculating interest, it is ordered that the claimant/appellant will not be entitled to interest for a period of 374 days, which represents the period of delay caused in filing the appeal.
The appeal is ordered accordingly.

Sd/-
EASWARAN S. JUDGE vnk/-
